description: This source file defines a PHP class 'RequestPasswordSuccessController' within the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Authentication\Controller'. The class extends an abstract controller and implements an interface, primarily to handle the display of a 'password reset success' view in a web application. It sets up a component and template for rendering a confirmation page after a password reset request.

classes.name: RequestPasswordSuccessController
classes.description: Controller handling the password reset success page, setting up a Vue component with no header template.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the view for rendering by creating a component with identifier 'reset-password-success' and sets the template to 'no_header.html.twig'.
